subject: Future Tech
title: Nano Vaccines and Immunotherapy
description: A quick win: understand Nano Vaccines and Immunotherapy.

hook.text: The COVID mRNA vaccines saved 20 million lives in their first year.

buildup.text: mRNA is destroyed in seconds by the body's enzymes.

discovery.text: Moderna and BioNTech now use the same nanotech platform for cancer vaccines, flu, RSV, and dozens of other diseases.

twist.text: Nanoparticle vaccines can carry multiple antigens at once.

climax.text: Personalized cancer vaccines use nanoparticles to deliver custom mRNA targeting a patient's unique tumor.

punchline.text: The pandemic proved nanotech saves lives at global scale.

quiz.question: Why are lipid nanoparticles essential for mRNA vaccines?
options: They boost the immune response directly
They protect fragile mRNA from destruction in the body
They kill the virus on contact
